articles.summary: “It's hard to describe it as anything other than magic.” Deepthi Krishnan, Watsi’s representative at our first medical partner in India, shares what she's learned from the families she meets and what it means to witness the difference surgery can make.
articles.title: Behind every surgery

articles.summary: A WhatsApp group, a shared pool, and a lot of love. For years, Bidii Circle has looked out for one another in Nairobi. Now they're choosing patients around the world to support.
articles.title: How a circle of friends in Nairobi helps fund surgery around the world
